signal_attribution.reasoning_chain: Negative GEX (-$372M) with VIX in backwardation (-3.7%) puts us in the EXPLOSIVE regime, where bullish fear-buying is backtested at 65.5%. CAG 1.09 BULL-DELUDED (fear z=+1.47) confirms the crowd is too fearful. Spot sits between the 7,180 put wall and the 7,200 call wall, so targets anchor on those. Bearish flow (P/C 1.37, $24.14M SPY deep ITM puts) is mostly SPX hedging and is treated as a risk, not a driver. Regime confidence is only 27% and the tape is a downtrend, so conviction is capped at 36 intraday, 50 next-day (Friday half-day) and 58 for 30 days.
